description: Source code for SSL client session cache management in the Chromium project, including class definitions, session handling, expiration logic, and memory pressure responses.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache
classes.description: Manages SSL client session caching, including lookup, insertion, expiration, and memory pressure handling.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a unique key for SSL session cache entries, with comparison operators.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry
classes.description: Stores one or two SSL_SESSION objects for reuse and expiration management.

methods.name: TieKeyFields
methods.description: Creates a tuple of references to key fields for comparison.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a session from the cache if valid and not expired.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a session into the cache under a specific key.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::ClearEarlyData
methods.description: Removes early data from sessions associated with a key.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::FlushForServer
methods.description: Removes all cache entries for a specific server.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if a session has expired based on current time.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry::Push
methods.description: Adds a session to the entry, managing single-use sessions.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry::Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a session from the entry.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry::ExpireSessions
methods.description: Expires sessions that are no longer valid.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::FlushExpiredSessions
methods.description: Removes expired sessions from the cache.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::OnMemoryPressure
methods.description: Handles memory pressure events by flushing sessions accordingly.
